findings.label: Պնդում․ ոչ տրիվիալ տարածությունների անհաշվելի արտադրյալը 1-ին հաշվելի չէ (first countable)
findings.why: Codex read 'nontrivial' as 'more than one point' and proposed 'Hausdorff with at least two points'. She defines it at predicted 0:10:35-0:10:53: spaces with an open set other than the empty set and the whole space, i.e. not the trivial (indiscrete) topology, which is exactly the hypothesis the theorem needs. Codex's version is a different, stronger statement.
